name: measurement-mapping
title: Mapping of OMOP measurement to several DT4H profiles

mapping.description: Mapping from OMOP Measurement to the DT4H LabResult profile

precondition.name: isLabResult
precondition.expression: mpp:getConcept(%labResults, measurement_concept_id.toString()).exists() and (iif(value_as_number.exists(), mpp:convertAndReturnQuantity(%unitConversionMap, measurement_concept_id.toString(), value_as_number, unit_concept_id.toString()), iif((value_as_number.empty() and value_source_value.matches('^resultado/ *([<>]=?) *([0-9]+([.,][0-9]+)?) */value$')), mpp:convertAndReturnQuantity(%unitConversionMap, measurement_concept_id.toString(), value_source_value.replaceMatches('^resultado/ *([<>]=?) *([0-9]+([.,][0-9]+)?) */value$', '$2').replace(',', '.').toDecimal(), unit_concept_id.toString()), {})).exists() or iif(value_as_number.exists() or iif(value_as_number.exists(), mpp:convertAndReturnQuantity(%unitConversionMap, measurement_concept_id.toString(), value_as_number, unit_concept_id.toString()), iif((value_as_number.empty() and value_source_value.matches('^resultado/ *([<>]=?) *([0-9]+([.,][0-9]+)?) */value$')), mpp:convertAndReturnQuantity(%unitConversionMap, measurement_concept_id.toString(), value_source_value.replaceMatches('^resultado/ *([<>]=?) *([0-9]+([.,][0-9]+)?) */value$', '$2').replace(',', '.').toDecimal(), unit_concept_id.toString()), {})).exists(), {}, trms:translateToCoding(value_as_concept_id.toString(), 'https://www.ohdsi.org/omop', 'https://ai4hf.eu/fhir/mappings/ConceptMap/omop-to-snomed')).exists())

value.id: {{mpp:getHashedId('Observation', measurement_id.toString() & '|' & person_id.toString() & '|' & measurement_concept_id.toString() & '|' & measurement_date.toString() & '|' & measurement_datetime.toString() & '|' & measurement_time.toString() & '|' & measurement_type_concept_id.toString() & '|' & operator_concept_id.toString() & '|' & value_as_number.toString() & '|' & value_as_concept_id.toString() & '|' & unit_concept_id.toString() & '|' & range_low.toString() & '|' & range_high.toString() & '|' & provider_id.toString() & '|' & visit_occurrence_id.toString() & '|' & visit_detail_id.toString() & '|' & measurement_source_value.toString() & '|' & measurement_source_concept_id.toString() & '|' & unit_source_value.toString() & '|' & unit_source_concept_id.toString() & '|' & value_source_value.toString() & '|' & measurement_event_id.toString() & '|' & meas_event_field_concept_id.toString())}}

valueQuantity.{{#q}}: {{iif(value_as_number.exists(), mpp:convertAndReturnQuantity(%unitConversionMap, measurement_concept_id.toString(), value_as_number, unit_concept_id.toString()), iif((value_as_number.empty() and value_source_value.matches('^resultado/ *([<>]=?) *([0-9]+([.,][0-9]+)?) */value$')), mpp:convertAndReturnQuantity(%unitConversionMap, measurement_concept_id.toString(), value_source_value.replaceMatches('^resultado/ *([<>]=?) *([0-9]+([.,][0-9]+)?) */value$', '$2').replace(',', '.').toDecimal(), unit_concept_id.toString()), {}))}}

value.interpretation: {{* iif((%vitalSignCodings.where(code='89579-7' or code='10839-9' or code='67151-1' or code='6598-7').exists() or measurement_concept_id = 40769783 or measurement_concept_id = 4020703 or measurement_concept_id = 3019800), iif(unit_concept_id = 8725 and value_as_number.exists(), utl:createFhirCodeableConcept('http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/observation-interpretation', iif(value_as_number > 14, 'H', 'N'), {}), utl:createFhirCodeableConcept('http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/v3-NullFlavor', 'UNK', 'unknown')), {})}}

valueCodeableConcept.{{#vc}}: {{iif(value_as_number.exists() or iif(value_as_number.exists(), mpp:convertAndReturnQuantity(%unitConversionMap, measurement_concept_id.toString(), value_as_number, unit_concept_id.toString()), iif((value_as_number.empty() and value_source_value.matches('^resultado/ *([<>]=?) *([0-9]+([.,][0-9]+)?) */value$')), mpp:convertAndReturnQuantity(%unitConversionMap, measurement_concept_id.toString(), value_source_value.replaceMatches('^resultado/ *([<>]=?) *([0-9]+([.,][0-9]+)?) */value$', '$2').replace(',', '.').toDecimal(), unit_concept_id.toString()), {})).exists(), {}, trms:translateToCoding(value_as_concept_id.toString(), 'https://www.ohdsi.org/omop', 'https://ai4hf.eu/fhir/mappings/ConceptMap/omop-to-snomed'))}}

value.subject: {{mpp:createFhirReferenceWithHashedId('Patient', person_id.toString())}}

mapping.description: Mapping OMOP Measurement to the DT4H Echocardiograph profile, focusing exclusively on Left Ventricular Ejection Fraction (LVEF).

precondition.name: isLVEF
precondition.expression: ((measurement_concept_id = 3019817 or measurement_concept_id = 3027172) and unit_concept_id = 8554 and value_as_number.exists()) or (measurement_concept_id = 4108582 and value_as_number.empty() and (value_as_concept_id = 765171 or value_as_concept_id = 4047088 or value_as_concept_id = 764973 or value_as_concept_id = 764982 or value_as_concept_id = 764978))
